Card Text:

Master
Take control of an ally controlled by another Methuselah until the end
of your turn.

----

Am I correct in assuming that the ally you take control of remains
tapped if it was tapped, thus making this card almost useless?

Messages.Author: John M. Baker
Messages.Body:
Ethan Burrow wrote:
>Card Text:
>
>Master
>Take control of an ally controlled by another Methuselah until the end
>of your turn.
>
>----
>
>Am I correct in assuming that the ally you take control of remains
>tapped if it was tapped, thus making this card almost useless?

Well, don't forget that since an ally can't act on the turn it's called,
you do have a turn to deal with an ally before it even becomes a
threat. But, otherwise, yes, you're right.

John Baker
